name: appwrangler
description: See what's slowing your Mac and fix it: per-app CPU, efficiency-core and memory control for Apple Silicon.
long_description:
AppWrangler's MCP server. Your assistant can list what's running and explain each app, suggest settings with the reason and benefit, change per-app CPU limits, efficiency cores and memory limits (with your approval), show CPU, energy and memory statistics, free memory by freezing apps you haven't used for a while, and undo changes.

Uses the installed AppWrangler app when there is one (recommended: it does the live enforcement and has already been approved by macOS), otherwise the server included here. Install the menu bar app with: brew tap intarso/appwrangler https://github.com/IntarsO/AppWrangler && brew install --cask appwrangler. Without it, the server can still explain apps and edit the rules the app applies when it starts.

args: app=/Applications/AppWrangler.app/Contents/MacOS/AppWrangler; if [ -x "$app" ]; then exec "$app" mcp; else exec "$0" mcp; fi

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Is AppWrangler running, paused, what's frozen; the Mac's chip, memory and pressure

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: Running apps with CPU, memory, energy, what each one is and how safe it is to limit

tools.name: explain_app
tools.description: What an app or process is, who makes it, and its current usage and rule

tools.name: get_app_settings
tools.description: Everything about one app: usage, every setting, who manages it, suggestions

tools.name: suggest_settings
tools.description: Recommended settings for what's running, with reasons and ready-to-apply actions

tools.name: get_impact_stats
tools.description: CPU and energy saved, memory pressure and swap, what AppWrangler cost

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: All saved per-app rules

tools.name: get_preferences
tools.description: App-wide settings: Auto mode, idle freezing, low-memory level, alerts

tools.name: configure_app
tools.description: Change any combination of an app's settings in one call

tools.name: set_preferences
tools.description: Change app-wide settings

tools.name: set_auto_mode
tools.description: Auto mode and idle-app freezing on or off

tools.name: set_cpu_limit
tools.description: Cap an app's CPU

tools.name: set_efficiency_cores
tools.description: Run an app on the efficiency cores

tools.name: set_memory_limit
tools.description: Notify, freeze or quit when an app stays over a memory limit

tools.name: set_low_memory_action
tools.description: What to do with an app when the Mac is low on memory

tools.name: set_rule_conditions
tools.description: Only on battery, in Low Power Mode, when hot, or on a schedule

tools.name: set_rule_enabled
tools.description: Turn a rule on or off

tools.name: remove_rule
tools.description: Delete an app's rule

tools.name: freeze_app
tools.description: Freeze or resume an app now

tools.name: free_memory
tools.description: Freeze apps the user hasn't used for a while; each resumes on switch

tools.name: pause_limits
tools.description: Pause or resume all CPU limits

tools.name: undo_last_change
tools.description: Revert the last rule change
